verification_gates.name: Node.js 22 runtime
verification_gates.command: node -e "const major = Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if (major < 22) { console.error('Node.js 22+ required'); process.exit(1); }"

items.description: The current user-facing compatibility contract is captured by executable regression tests before structural changes begin.
steps: Exercise the extension through registered Pi event handlers and commands, not by restating private helper implementations.
Assert the existing trace name and hierarchy: pi-agent, agent.prompt, agent.turn, llm-response, and tool:<name> with the current parent relationships.

Assert current command registration, configuration precedence, settings bridge behavior, raw-trace record shapes, export behavior, local-init output, redaction defaults, and compiled entrypoint expectations.
Demonstrate that at least one new compatibility test fails against a deliberately incompatible fixture or mutation and passes against the baseline implementation.
items.regression_notes: Added a registered extension compatibility harness covering trace hierarchy and IDs, source precedence, settings reloads, commands, raw records, redaction, local init, export, packaging, and mutation sensitivity.

items.description: The package has an explicit Node.js 22+ major-release toolchain contract with a reproducible npm lockfile and non-destructive CI checks.
steps: Update package metadata and TypeScript configuration for Node.js 22+ without changing the compiled dist/index.js package entrypoint.
Create and commit the npm lockfile used by CI and local clean installs.
Update CI to run clean install, non-mutating Biome check, typecheck, tests, build, and package dry-run on the supported Node runtime.
Verify a clean install from the lockfile and confirm no current command, config, raw-trace, export, or local setup test regresses.
items.regression_notes: Updated Node.js metadata and ES2023 compiler target, added a lockfile generated from an empty package-only checkout, and aligned CI with Node 22, npm ci, non-mutating Biome, typecheck, tests, build, and package dry-run. Targeted compatibility, clean npm ci, full gates, and package dry-run passed. Clean generation retains three nested @earendil peer entries without direct integrity fields because the published peer package has its own shrinkwrap metadata.

items.description: Runtime state is isolated by Pi session so overlapping asynchronous sessions cannot contaminate each other.
steps: Introduce a named session-state owner using AsyncLocalStorage or an equivalent explicit session boundary.
Route every Pi lifecycle callback through the correct session context while keeping shared immutable configuration and the shared telemetry runtime outside per-session mutable state.
Overlap two sessions with interleaved prompt, turn, generation, tool, model-select, compact, and shutdown events.
Assert trace identity, counters, model/provider, active observations, raw-trace paths, final output, and cleanup remain isolated.
items.regression_notes: Added a registered-handler session isolation harness for overlapping sessions, realistic filename versus Pi session IDs, independent extension runtimes, shared-client lease lifetime, per-session trace hierarchy and counters, raw-trace paths, final output, and late-event cleanup. Added post-await ownership checks before trace, span, and generation creation.

items.description: Agent and turn lifecycle behavior is moved behind explicit handler boundaries without changing emitted trace behavior.
steps: Extract agent prompt start/finalization and turn start/end behavior from the monolithic extension entrypoint into modules named by lifecycle ownership.
Keep the entrypoint responsible for command and event registration only, with dependencies passed explicitly to handlers.
Run the compatibility harness through the public extension registration path.
Assert the exact existing trace names, hierarchy, tags, trace input/output, aggregate usage, compact metadata, and cleanup behavior remain unchanged.
items.regression_notes: Extracted agent prompt and turn lifecycle handlers with explicit dependency injection while preserving public registration order and telemetry behavior. The registered compatibility harness, full gates, compiled build, and package dry-run passed after one supported review fix for Biome import organization.

items.description: Generation lifecycle behavior is owned by a dedicated handler with stable request correlation and existing usage and cost semantics.
steps: Extract provider request, context snapshot, streaming update, assistant message finalization, usage, cost, and score behavior behind a generation handler boundary.
Keep generation correlation stable under multiple turns and out-of-order provider metadata events.
Exercise normal text, thinking plus text, tool-call assistant messages, missing message_start, and provider error paths.
Assert each semantic model request produces at most one llm-response generation under the correct agent.turn span with existing input, output, usage, cost, and model behavior.
items.regression_notes: Added a registered-extension generation handler with per-turn request state, immutable input snapshots, retry-safe provider response metadata, missing message_start fallback, terminal error finalization, thinking/text streaming, tool-call messages, usage/cost scoring, and exact trace parentage. Targeted and full verification passed; the credential-gated E2E remains skipped.

items.description: Tool lifecycle behavior is owned by a dedicated handler with concurrent toolCallId correlation and unchanged raw and Langfuse output.
steps: Extract tool_call, tool_execution_start, progress, tool_result, and tool_execution_end handling behind a tool handler boundary.
Use toolCallId as the ownership key and tolerate either Pi start event and either completion event without duplication.
Exercise concurrent tools completing out of order, progress updates, image blocks, errors, missing completion, and interruption.
Assert one tool:<name> span per semantic call, correct parentage, duration and error metadata, and unchanged raw tool record formats.
items.regression_notes: Added registered-handler coverage for both start events, toolCallId correlation, concurrent out-of-order tools, progress updates, image blocks, provisional versus final completion status, result-only completion, interruption cleanup, one span/end call, parentage, duration/error metadata, raw record shapes, and redaction. Targeted tests, full gates, build, and package dry-run passed. GLM found no material issues. GPT Sol's supported provisional tool_result finding was fixed by finalizing normal completion from tool_execution_end and result-aware cleanup; the regression now asserts exact end counts, progress output, status disagreement, and result-only behavior. Credentialed E2E remains skipped; local registered-path coverage exercises the real handlers without paid credentials.

items.description: Observation lifecycle transitions are idempotent and all partial or interrupted runs finish without duplicate or dangling observations.
steps: Define explicit start, update, end, abandon, and cleanup rules for prompt, turn, generation, and tool observations.
Exercise duplicate start/end events, end-before-start, session switch, fork, compaction, config refresh, agent failure, and session shutdown.
Assert repeated completion is a no-op, abandoned observations receive a precise status, and maps and session state are empty after cleanup.
Verify finalization preserves the existing Langfuse client persistence rule and does not shut down the shared runtime after each prompt.
items.regression_notes: Added registered-handler regressions for duplicate prompt, agent, turn, generation, and tool starts and ends; end-before-start; parent-child generation cleanup; result-only tools; host-shaped agent failure status; session replacement and fork; compaction; config refresh; late-event cleanup; idempotent shutdown; and shared-client persistence. Targeted and full verification passed; credentialed E2E remains skipped.

items.description: Capture presets and configurable payload budgets are added without weakening current redaction or changing default capture behavior.
steps: Add metadata-only, prompts-only, conversations, and full-debug capture policies with fine-grained overrides and current behavior as the compatibility default.
Add configurable limits for ordinary strings, tool payload strings, nesting depth, array items, object keys, and total payload nodes, including an explicit unlimited value.
Apply one policy and shaping boundary consistently to prompt, system prompt, provider input, assistant output, tool I/O, metadata, raw traces, and Langfuse payloads.

Run a privacy matrix covering configured secrets, environment secrets, PII patterns, credentials, data URLs, large blobs, absolute paths, circular objects, deep trees, wide collections, and export always-on redaction.
items.regression_notes: Added registered-path privacy coverage and a shared payload-policy boundary for four presets, tri-state overrides, redaction-first recursive limits, mixed provider roles, raw traces, Langfuse payloads, and unbounded always-redacted exports. Fixed both adversarial review rounds' supported findings; full verification and package dry-run passed.

items.description: A typed Langfuse v5 and OpenTelemetry runtime facade replaces direct legacy SDK coupling while preserving the local client lifecycle contract.
steps: Replace the legacy langfuse dependency with the required Langfuse v5 and OpenTelemetry packages and update the lockfile.
Create a typed runtime facade for observation start, update, end, trace I/O, scoring, flush, and shutdown so lifecycle handlers do not import vendor SDK types directly.
Register and test asynchronous OTel context propagation and keep one shared runtime for all active sessions with explicit ownership and replacement rules.
Verify configuration changes rebuild the runtime cleanly while ordinary prompt completion leaves it alive.
items.regression_notes: Migrated to Langfuse v5 plus OpenTelemetry with a typed local facade, eager stable roots, valid caller trace IDs, selective propagation, metadata merging, final trace I/O ordering, serialized ownership-safe replacement, and observation cleanup. Added local real-export and registered-handler regressions; all runtime gates passed.

items.description: The active Langfuse v5 and OpenTelemetry path emits the existing local trace schema and telemetry semantics.
steps: Route agent, turn, generation, and tool handlers through the v5 runtime facade.
Map the existing pi-agent trace, agent.prompt span, agent.turn spans, llm-response generations, and tool:<name> spans onto v5 observations without renaming or reparenting them.
Exercise multiple turns, concurrent tools, usage and cost, streaming output, tags, release, environment, session IDs, scores, raw traces, and redaction through the public extension path.
Assert the emitted observation tree and trace I/O match the executable compatibility contract.
items.regression_notes: Added a real registered-extension integration against an ephemeral local HTTP endpoint. It verifies pi-agent trace naming, agent.prompt/agent.turn/llm-response/tool hierarchy and parent IDs, trace input/output, two turns, streaming updates, concurrent tools, release/environment/session/tags, usage/cost, score linkage, raw traces, and redaction. GLM found no material issues. GPT Sol's supported hermetic-environment and assertion-precision findings were fixed by isolating/restoring config env, pinning capture/autostart settings, aggregating OTLP batches, and asserting exact attributes and scores. Targeted and full gates passed; credentialed E2E remains skipped.

items.description: Telemetry shutdown is bounded and a tested REST fallback preserves completed traces when OTel data is not visible.
steps: Put finite timeouts around OTel flush, score flush, client shutdown, and tracer shutdown without shutting down per prompt.
Capture the minimum redacted trace and observation facts required to retry ingestion after OTel flush.
When a completed trace is not visible after a bounded check, ingest it through the Langfuse REST batch API exactly once.

Stall each shutdown dependency independently and verify completion remains bounded; verify fallback preserves trace ID, parent IDs, trace I/O, generation model and usage fields, tool errors, timestamps, and redaction.
items.regression_notes: Added a typed REST fallback adapter with bounded OTel, score, client, and tracer flush/shutdown; redacted completed-trace snapshots; prompt-flush draining; exactly-once retirement; trace-name preservation; parent, trace-I/O, generation, tool-error, timestamp, and redaction retention; and 3.5 MB batch chunking. Targeted runtime and ephemeral local HTTP tests passed. Full gates passed with 80 tests and 1 credential-gated E2E skipped. GLM approved. GPT Sol's supported trace-name, snapshot-retention/batch-size, and fallback-module findings were fixed; no second review was launched.

items.description: Safe source identity and additive generation and health telemetry are available without changing existing fields or exposing local secrets.
steps: Collect whitelisted Git source metadata with sanitized remote host and path, repository identity, branch, and commit; emit only non-git markers outside usable repositories.
Capture supported scalar model parameters, provider response metadata, and time to first token on llm-response generations.
Add trace-level tool_call_count, turn_count, total_tool_errors, tool_success_rate, and session_had_errors scores plus tool_is_error observation scores.
Verify credentialed remotes, absolute paths, unknown override keys, non-Git folders, zeroed provider cost data, missing metadata, and score failures remain contained and do not break the run.
items.regression_notes: Added safe Git source metadata with credential-free remotes, non-Git markers, whitelisted cross-platform-safe overrides, allowlisted provider/model telemetry, streamed TTFT, zero-cost omission, tool and prompt health scores, and non-fatal score failures. Registered compatibility and source metadata regressions cover redaction-disabled unknown provider fields, interrupted prompts, credentialed/local paths, zero costs, and score failures. Targeted tests passed with 19 tests; all verification gates passed with 86 tests and 1 credential-gated E2E skipped. GLM approved after dead-code/import fixes; GPT Sol's supported provider-metadata allowlist, canonical interruption health score, and UNC/device path findings were fixed; no second review was launched.

items.description: Users gain safe status, connectivity-test, and privacy commands while every existing command, config source, settings event, and self-hosted workflow remains compatible.
steps: Add /langfuse-status without exposing secret keys and include config source, host, masked public key, capture policy, active-run state, config path, runtime mode, and last runtime error.
Add /langfuse-test with a timeout-bounded authenticated check and isolated test trace that does not interrupt an active run.
Add /langfuse-privacy to inspect or persist capture presets through the existing configuration model.

Verify /langfuse-init, /langfuse:toggle, /langfuse:export, extension-settings registration and change events, config precedence, local autostart, generated Langfuse Server v3 Compose files, existing files, credentials, and volumes remain unchanged and non-destructive.
items.regression_notes: Added registered-path coverage for safe status fields and secret masking, authenticated success/401/timeout/missing-key connectivity behavior, direct isolated ingestion without shared-runtime flushes, active-run preservation, bridge-stale privacy persistence, effective mixed config provenance, existing commands, settings events, local Server v3 init, export redaction, and packaging. Targeted tests passed with 47 tests across six files; all verification gates passed with 89 tests and one credential-gated E2E skipped. GLM and GPT Sol review findings were all supported and fixed; no second review was launched.

items.description: The refactor is locally end-to-end verified and packaged as a documented Node.js 22+ major-release candidate without publishing it.
steps: Add a bounded local integration harness that drives the real registered extension event path through session state, handlers, payload policy, v5 runtime facade, observation export, scoring, raw traces, and shutdown without paid credentials.

Install from the committed lockfile in a clean temporary checkout, run every verification gate, create the package tarball, install it into a temporary Pi-compatible fixture, and load the compiled dist/index.js entrypoint.
Run a production dependency audit and resolve every high or critical issue introduced by the refactor; do not mask audit failures.

Update README, architecture, settings, self-hosting, privacy, troubleshooting, and migration documentation for the Node.js 22+ major release; prepare publish workflow checks without publishing, tagging, or creating a release.
